plugins.name: alynki
plugins.description: Loads your organisation's governed context — policy, product context, and the workstreams, gates and runs that define how work is done — into every session, scoped to your credential

plugins.name: alynki-sealed
plugins.description: Sealed variant: a local component (alynki-local) runs on this machine — it decrypts your Alynki context locally and does chunked saves and paged loads here, so the hosted service serves and stores ciphertext only. Requires alynki-local on PATH
